premises.text: Typical search stacks force separate changes to database, search index, and web server whenever the index is modified
premises.evidence_span: every time we wanted to modify the index, we had to change the system in three separate places

premises.text: ThriftDB combines database, search index, and web server into one database-with-search system
premises.evidence_span: ThriftDB is just combining the database, the search index, and the web server into one system

premises.text: Data is modeled natively as objects with attributes so apps put objects in, get objects back, and search across them
